post.description: The filename is display metadata only. The server generates the object key, validates extension/MIME/signature and size, fingerprints the bytes, and fails access closed until malware scanning reports clean.

get.summary: Authorize a reviewer-scoped 300-second private document grant
get.description: Requires a verified Admin with admin:documents.review. The document must be active and clean. The response is a short-lived exact-object GET grant and never exposes a storage key or permanent URL.

delete.summary: Delete an owned private document and revoke its delivery path

get.summary: List dynamic administrative roles and the approved capability catalog
get.description: Requires admin:roles.view. The response exposes the caller's effective permissions and derives availableActions server-side.

post.summary: Create a dynamic administrative role
post.description: Requires admin:roles.manage and a reason. View Only roles accept only .view capabilities; persisted roles never accept wildcards. The mutation and its redacted audit record commit atomically.

patch.summary: Update a dynamic administrative role with optimistic concurrency
patch.description: Requires admin:roles.manage and a reason. Deactivation revokes grants from that role; the request version prevents lost updates. The mutation and its redacted audit record commit atomically.

get.summary: List append-only sensitive-action audit records
get.description: Requires admin:audit.view. Filters are allowlisted, snapshots are redacted and bounded, and signed URLs, credentials, tokens, and sensitive personal identifiers are never exposed.

get.summary: Get one append-only sensitive-action audit record
get.description: Requires admin:audit.view. Authorization is evaluated for every request and the response remains no-store.

get.summary: List locations and neighborhoods
get.description: Requires admin:locations.view. Filters and sorting are allowlisted and pagination is bounded.

post.summary: Create a location or neighborhood
post.description: Requires admin:locations.manage. Uses strict localized names, a unique stable slug, deterministic ordering, optional coordinates, and reason-bearing audit.

patch.summary: Update, reorder, move, or activate a location resource
patch.description: Requires admin:locations.manage, the current optimistic version, and a reason. Neighborhood parents must exist.

delete.description: Requires admin:locations.manage, the current optimistic version, and a reason. Child-neighborhood and Provider references fail closed.

get.summary: List non-Admin account projections
get.description: Requires admin:users.view. Results are bounded, deterministically ordered, paginated, and exclude administrator accounts and internal moderation data.

get.summary: Get one non-Admin account projection
get.description: Requires admin:users.view. Administrator accounts and unrelated targets are not exposed.

get.summary: List Provider application projections
get.description: Requires admin:providers.view. Results are bounded, deterministically ordered, paginated, and exclude private document delivery data.

get.summary: Get one Provider application projection
get.description: Requires admin:providers.view. Document metadata is explicit and excludes storage keys, permanent URLs, and internal review data.

post.summary: Apply a reason-bearing account state transition
post.description: Requires admin:users.manage. Provider approval, rejection, needs-information, and suspension use the dedicated provider-review route. Admin targets and self-transitions fail closed. Every successful transition revokes active refresh sessions and appends traceable transition evidence.

post.summary: Review a Provider application and its account state atomically
post.description: Requires admin:providers.review. The providerId is the current Provider application ID. Verification means platform administrative approval only and never government, ownership, registry, OCR, legal, bank, or other automatic verification.

get.summary: Read the authenticated provider's effective commission policy
get.description: Returns a verified provider-owned, read-only commission projection. No universal commission value is assumed when no active policy is persisted.

get.summary: List active payment proofs for manual review
get.description: Returns a bounded, status-filterable administrative projection for verified administrators with payment-review permission. Private storage and bank-verification claims are excluded.

post.summary: Approve or reject a private payment proof
post.description: A verified administrator with the payment-review permission must provide a reason. Review is manual, version-checked, audit-backed, and never represents bank verification.

get.summary: List advertising requests for authorized administrators
get.description: Returns a bounded administrative projection with provider identity and the latest manual quote when present. Private payment-proof storage and internal audit data are excluded.

post.summary: Schedule an approved advertising request

get.summary: List projects for authorized administrators
List versioned commission policies for authorized administrators
get.description: Returns persisted percentage, fixed, or exempt policies with explicit scope, effective dates, versions, and no universal fallback value.

post.summary: Create a draft commission policy
post.description: Creates a persisted draft policy. Activation and effective-window conflict handling remain server-controlled; no universal commission is assumed.

get.summary: Read an account's effective commission for authorized administrators
get.description: Returns the explicit account override, default policy, or none projection for the requested effective timestamp. No universal commission is assumed and administrative metadata is not exposed.

put.summary: Create a draft account commission override
put.description: Creates a persisted draft account override with strict value and effective-window validation. The operation never implies settlement or a universal commission.

get.summary: List commission exceptions for authorized administrators
get.description: Returns persisted account-scoped percentage, fixed, or exempt exception drafts and approved states with strict filters and required reasons.

post.summary: Create a draft commission exception
post.description: Creates a persisted draft account exception with a required business reason and strict value/effective-window validation. No settlement or bank-verification claim is made.

get.summary: List commission confirmations for authorized administrators
get.description: Returns persisted acknowledgement state, policy version, effective timestamp, and safe source references. No private provider documents, storage keys, or settlement claims are exposed.

get.summary: List commission change history for authorized administrators
get.description: Returns validated, redacted audit projections for commission policies, exceptions, account overrides, and confirmations with before/after snapshots, actor, reason, and effective dates.

get.summary: List administrator accounts for an authorized administrator
get.description: Requires admin:staff.view. The response is a safe administrator projection and never contains credentials or password material.

post.summary: Create an administrator account
post.description: Requires admin:staff.manage. Credentials are provisioned through the approved authentication boundary and are never accepted or returned here.

get.summary: Get one administrator account
get.description: Requires admin:staff.view. The response is a safe administrator projection without credentials, audit data, or internal authorization records.

patch.summary: Update, disable, or enable an administrator account
patch.description: Requires admin:staff.manage. Updates use an expected version and a bounded reason; self-lockout and removal of the last active Super Admin are rejected.

refreshCookie.name: sadat_refresh
refreshCookie.description: Opaque rotating refresh token. Never exposed in a response body.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access token issued by the shared authentication session boundary.

signedGrant.name: signature
signedGrant.description: Short-lived exact-object signature. The URL must also carry its expiry query parameter.

X-Request-Id.description: Validated request correlation identifier; generated when the inbound value is absent or malformed.

Traceparent.description: W3C trace context for this API span.

AdminLoginRequest.description: Role-agnostic password login. The normalized email is globally unique across seeker, provider, and administrator accounts.

NormalizedPhone.description: Canonical E.164 phone number after removing allowed presentation separators or converting a 00 prefix

NormalizedEmail.description: Trimmed lowercase mailbox bound to the OTP challenge and account

RegistrationToken.description: Single-use opaque authority returned by verified registration OTP.

url.description: Ephemeral bearer URL; never persist, log, audit, analyze, or list.

AuditSnapshot.description: Bounded JSON snapshot redacted before persistence and again before delivery. Secret, token, credential, signed-URL, email, and phone values are not exposed.

otp.description: Present when the authentication runtime is installed
